issue.title: Patch pane declares entry_open with no action serving it, muted by a one-entry conformance whitelist

task_type_fields.impact:
IMPACT: the Patch pane's derived contract lies about itself. Every consumer that reads
the contract -- `sase artifact pane show`, the help modal's capability rows, and any
future host that drives panes from the contract -- is told the pane supports entry
open when no key serves it. This is the same class of defect epic sase-tj.10 was
created to repair on the Agent pane (a capability declared ON with no reachable
action); the Agent pane was fixed and the Patch pane was whitelisted instead.

Two acceptable fixes, and the choice should be recorded: either register a
`patches_view_selected`-style action for ENTRY_OPEN on the Patch pane, or suppress
`entry_open` in the Patch pane's contract the way the Agent pane now suppresses it
(src/sase/ace/tui/_artifact_tab_contract_rules.py, `provider_suppressed`). Either way,
delete the `_KNOWN_UNREACHABLE_CAPABILITIES` whitelist entry and the comment above it
so the guard covers every pane again.

PROPOSED BY: closed phase bead sase-tj.10.2 of epic sase-tj.10. The phase agent wrote
in the harness comment that it had "recorded [this] as a proposed follow-up on
sase-tj.10.2 for the epic's land agent to triage", but `sase stitch create`
auto-closed that bead when 9b4f7d41a landed and the note was never written, so the
code comment is the only surviving record. Filed here by the sase-tj.10 land agent.
Not caused by sase-tj.10: the Patch pane predates it and the whitelist only made an
older gap visible.
task_type_fields.repro:
REPRO:
  sase artifact pane show patches
reports `entry_open ON` for the Patch pane. Its Keys table binds no per-row open
action, and no `patches_view_selected`-style action is registered anywhere in
`CAPABILITY_HOST_ACTIONS[PaneCapability.ENTRY_OPEN]`
(src/sase/ace/tui/_artifact_tab_actions.py). "Enter" on that pane commits the
persistent filter query instead of opening the selected row.

The gap is currently muted by a one-entry whitelist added while writing the guard:

  tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/harness.py:110
  _KNOWN_UNREACHABLE_CAPABILITIES = frozenset({("patches", PaneCapability.ENTRY_OPEN)})

Remove that entry and
`tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/...::check_declared_capabilities_are_reachable`
fails for `patches` on `entry_open`.
